nodes.question: How can energy sustainability in harmony with environmental sustainability be achieved through energy efficiency and renewable penetration?
nodes.answer: Energy sustainability in harmony with environmental sustainability can be achieved by embedding energy efficiency and renewable penetration. This can be done through the implementation of appropriate policies and programs by federal and state entities.
